_contract: What Research A's L40S engineering check runs and what it reports, fixed before any GPU run and bound into the phase identity. Read by scripts/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/l40s_check.py, whose `verdict` re-derives every status from the run's evidence and the values here. The check runs the phase's own formal code paths on DIAGNOSTIC inputs; nothing it builds is training data, a calibration profile, an initialization, an evaluation or a result, and it reads no eval-set-1 item. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
decided_by: maintainer brief 2026-10-29 'Research A L40S-First Hardware and Budget Correction', section 3
_free_memory: each operation's margin: the card's total less its peak RESERVED memory (PyTorch) or the device's peak used memory (the engine, nvidia-smi), at least 4 GiB wanted. A smaller margin or an out-of-memory error is reported with the operation and its memory management; it never shortens a sequence, drops data, changes batch semantics or lowers a context

diagnostic_tasks._: build_tasks.py diagnostic: 64 tasks disjoint from T0, the order, the pools, eval-set-1's held-out prompts and the calibration prompts

generation._: teacher_session.run_stage on the diagnostic tasks: the teacher session's runner (run_battery --mode generate), engine settings, data-construction limit 8,184 - prompt, and each mode's template kwargs and official sampling (generation_protocol.json). Measured per mode: generated tokens, wall seconds, tokens per second, the engine's KV cache capacity (its log) and the device's peak used memory

evaluation_engine._: run_battery --mode eval with --trained-context at the teacher's supported 40,960 (generation_protocol.json teacher_evaluation.context), nucleus_v1, the full remaining context per item (P18): the engine the teacher's evaluation builds. H-N keeps the diagnostic short; the engine's memory at 40,960 does not depend on the mode. Measured: it starts, its KV capacity and maximum concurrency at 40,960 (its log), peak used memory

train.student: the A-E stand-in (H1-PA PCA-Original seed 20260726, E1's PCA checkpoint, ae_launch.STAND_IN): the student geometry (596M); a stand-in for memory and step time only, never trained on as a result
train._: the formal recipe: the seed's E1 config with recovery_units.recipe_overrides (Top-200 + tail KD at the target positions resolved from the forward baseline, kd_scope assistant, document isolation, the hybrid teacher on the fly) and only where/how-long keys changed, micro-batch 1, on each mode's diagnostic documents packed document_isolated at 8,192 (every turn that forms a token document; correctness is never read). Measured per mode: peak allocated and reserved memory, seconds per optimizer step after warmup, non-padding tokens per second

initialization._: D4 Top-1's fixed path (initialization.PATH, seed, target geometry) on the hybrid root, materialized by initialization.materialize with the Stage-0 profiles THEMSELVES (Thinking-2507's items on the same prompts: the same length regime, up to 7,787 tokens) instead of the hybrid's, at the forward baseline's execution, then -- only on a CUDA out-of-memory error -- at the design's fallback micro-batch (d4_scale_design.json :: initialization.execution.on_out_of_memory). Measured per step: seconds, peak allocated and reserved memory. Its product is a diagnostic, deleted with the pod: never an initialization of this study

_order: the longest and riskiest last, so an initialization failure costs no other measurement
